name: opencode-runtime-fallback
description: Automatic model fallback plugin for OpenCode. Switches to backup models when API errors occur.

scripts.test:integration: bun run build && bun run foreground-task.integration.ts
scripts.test:integration:v2: bun run build && bun run v2.integration.ts && bun run v2.integration.ts --hung-primary && bun run v2.integration.ts --hung-backup && bun run v2.integration.ts --legacy-config && bun run v2.integration.ts --legacy-config --markdown-agent && bun run v2.integration.ts --legacy-config --foreground-task && bun run v2.integration.ts --compaction --notifications && bun run v2.integration.ts --compaction --hung-primary && bun run v2.integration.ts --compaction --hung-backup && bun run v2.integration.ts --compaction --cancel-compaction && bun run v2.integration.ts --compaction --legacy-config && bun run v2.integration.ts --compaction --anthropic-backup && bun run v2.integration.ts --tui && bun run test:integration:v2:background && bun run v2.integration.ts --streaming-tool-input
scripts.test:integration:v2:background: bun run v2.integration.ts --background-task && bun run v2.integration.ts --background-task --hung-primary && bun run v2.integration.ts --background-task --background-no-error && bun run v2.integration.ts --background-task --background-exhausted && bun run v2.integration.ts --background-task --native-reload && bun run v2.integration.ts --background-task --native-cancel && bun run v2.integration.ts --synthetic-contract
